ChatGPT o1- Model- Transforming to Human Capabilities

20 September 2024·Impulse Digital

Introduction:

OpenAI’s latest update has left us stunned!  

The new OpenAI’s o1 Model takes a significant stride in transforming Artificial Intelligence capabilities. It is no shock that “Your AI Model can now think and then respond just like a human”.  

With each transformational update by OpenAI comes a promising user experience delivering faster, better and more accurate responses. Thereby making it more useful and simplifying the overall experience of the user. However, OpenAI continues to make headlines with newer updates and models. So, if you’re wondering what this new update is all about this blog is for you.  

What’s OpenAI’s o1 model?

The new model is enabled with the ability to think and then respond. This feature makes it suitable for various industries that require reasoning and research.  

According to a variety of tests conducted it also proves to be useful in various fields yielding better results and has capabilities to solve multiple problems related to mathematics, coding among many of its other abilities.

Here are the Advantages and Disadvantages of OpenAI’s o1 Model:

Advantages of OpenAI’s o1   Disadvantages of OpenAI’s o1  
Suitable for complex reasoning task  

Like solving 

  • Mathematics 
  • Coding 
  • Physics 
 Consumes added time to generate response.  
Applicable for advanced and 

 

 technical thinking and reasoning 
  • No access to web browsing or information

Inclusive to more industries like

Not applicable for free users  
Access to ChatGPT plus users automatically from launch day.  Working in process of increasing rates and enabling more users.  

 

Not just this model, it has also launched a OpenAI O1- Mini model:

The model is effective and will be applicable for wide users. It is both faster and cheaper that makes it cost-effective and easily accessible. It is effective in solving complex codes although it lacks broad world knowledge.  

(Click on the alpha model o1 mini to enable it) 

So, you now have 2 more options in various versions of OpenAI to choose from to make a more informed decision and generate accurate responses. The o1 Mini Model can now be accessed by free users as well.  

How can you switch to these models?

From the icon on top, one can select their desired model based on usage and switch to other models easily. Among both the models ChatGPT O1- model can be used by plus users only. On the other hand, o1-mini model can be used by all users including free users.

Conclusion:
